## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Cardiff, United Kingdom. It starts at Hayes Way.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get ready for a supersonic day out at Aerospace Bristol. During your visit you'll have the chance to see incredible aeroplanes and helicopters, plus rockets, satellites and more.
>
> The star attraction is the last Concorde ever to fly. You can even step inside the iconic supersonic jet and see into the cockpit with your Aerospace Bristol tickets. Find out how this amazing aeroplane allowed VIP passengers to fly at 1,350mph on the edge of space.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €26.94. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 92 ratings and 59 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
